title: event_flatstore Module
content_markdown: The _event_flatstore_ module provides a logging facility for different events, triggered through the OpenSIPS Event Interface, directly from the OpenSIPS script. The module logs the events along with their parameters in plain text files.
overview: The _event_flatstore_ module provides a logging facility for different events, triggered through the OpenSIPS Event Interface, directly from the OpenSIPS script. The module logs the events along with their parameters in plain text files.

exported_parameters.name: max_open_sockets
exported_parameters.description: Defines the maximum number of simultaneously opened files by the module. If the maximum limit is reached, an error message will be thrown, and further subscriptions will only be possible after at least one of the current subscriptions will expire.

exported_parameters.name: delimiter
exported_parameters.description: Sets the separator between the parameters of the event in the logging file.

exported_parameters.name: escape_delimiter
exported_parameters.description: Optional replacement sequence that will be written _instead of_ the [`delimiter`](#param_delimiter "1.5.2.�delimiter (string)") whenever this character (or sequence) occurs inside a string parameter. This allows you to keep the log file parse-friendly even when user data itself may contain delimiter symbols.
exported_parameters.notes: If set, its length must be exactly equal to the length of delimiter.

exported_parameters.name: file_permissions
exported_parameters.description: Sets the permissions for the newly created logs. It expects a string representation of a octal value.

exported_parameters.name: suppress_event_name
exported_parameters.description: Suppresses the name of the event in the log file.

exported_parameters.name: rotate_period
exported_parameters.description: When used, it triggers a file auto-rotate. The period is matched against the absolute time of the machine, can be useful to trigger auto-rotate every minute, or every hour.
exported_parameters.example_code:
...
modparam("event\_flatstore", "rotate\_period", 60) # rotate every minute
modparam("event\_flatstore", "rotate\_period", 3660) # rotate every hour
...

exported_parameters.name: rotate_count
exported_parameters.description: Defines after how many written lines the log file is rotated. The value may exceed the 32-bit integer limit; in that case pass it _as a string_, e.g. "5000000000".

exported_parameters.name: rotate_size
exported_parameters.description: Sets the maximum size of a file before it is rotated. A size suffix of “k”, “m” or “g” (multiples of 1024) may be provided. Very large values can be supplied as strings, e.g. "8589934592" for 8 GiB.

exported_parameters.name: suffix
exported_parameters.description: Modifies the file that OpenSIPS writes events into by appending a suffix to the the file specified in the flatstore _socket_. The suffix can contain string formats (i.e. variables mixed with strings). The path of the resulted file is evaluated when the first event is raised/written in the file after a reload happend, or when the _rotate\_period_, if specified, triggers a rotate. This parameter does not affect the matching of the event socket - the matching will be done exclusively using the flatstore _socket_ registered.

exported_mi_functions.name: evi_flat_rotate
exported_mi_functions.description: It makes the processes reopen the file specified as a parameter to the command in order to be compatible with a logrotate command. If the function is not called after the mv command is executed, the module will continue to write in the renamed file.

exported_events.name: E_FLATSTORE_ROTATION
exported_events.description: The event is raised every time _event\_flatstore_ opens a new log file (manual **evi\_flat\_rotate**, auto-rotate by `rotate_period`, or thresholds `rotate_count`/`rotate_size`). External apps can subscribe to monitor log-rotation activity.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix epoch (seconds) when the rotation was performed.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: full path of the new log file.

parameters.name: old_filename
parameters.description: full path of the previous log file, or empty string if none existed.

configuration_examples.title: Set `rotate_period` parameter
configuration_examples.code:
...
modparam("event_flatstore", "rotate_period", 60) # rotate every minute
modparam("event_flatstore", "rotate_period", 3660) # rotate every hour
...
